frame_time_convention: frame start time; no center correction; short files are zero-padded to one frame

outputs.f0_hz: (frames,) FFT-autocorrelation F0 estimate; 0 means unvoiced/low confidence
outputs.f0_confidence_proxy: (frames,) normalized autocorrelation peak proxy; not calibrated probability
outputs.spectral_envelope: (frames,1025) log cepstrally smoothed magnitude envelope estimate
outputs.hnr_db_proxy: (frames,) autocorrelation-derived periodicity proxy in dB; not calibrated HNR
outputs.formants_hz_estimate: (frames,3) up to 3 coarse spectral peak estimates; zeros mean unavailable
outputs.formant_peak_strength_proxy: (frames,3) selected peak amplitude relative to largest envelope peak; not formant confidence probability
outputs.breathiness_proxy: (frames,) fraction of spectral power at/above 4 kHz in [0,1]

validation.input: mono WAV, exactly 44100 Hz, finite samples, non-empty
validation.output: all numeric arrays finite and first dimension aligned to frame_times_sec
validation.npz_write: atomic temporary file + replace; existing outputs require --overwrite

limitations: Descriptors are diagnostic estimates, not ground truth or production-grade acoustic analysis.
F0 autocorrelation may make octave errors or fail on breathy/unvoiced/noisy singing.
Formant estimation is coarse FFT/envelope peak picking; singing formants may be missed.
HNR, breathiness, aperiodicity, and voice-quality descriptors require manual/independent validation.
No forced alignment between audio, MIDI, lyrics, or phonemes is inferred.
P2 does not implement singing synthesis model training or waveform generation.
